known_secrets.text: Mara keeps a hidden grain reserve larger than what she reports to the Assembly.
She deliberately under-supplies Tarek's festival grain requests.
Some pre-Turning granary records are missing, not merely damaged.
She suspects the missing records were deliberately removed.
The old canal-side storage platforms sit on ground where salt-crust is spreading.

unknowns: Meaning of the Signs on the seals
The true size of her hidden reserve, known to no one else
Whether the missing granary records connect to Elira's erasure
